2010_014_120610spmtg.paragraph: Agenda packet for a Special Meeting of the Troy School District Board of Trustees held December 6, 2010, at 7:00 PM in the Administration Building, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098. It contains the meeting notice and agenda, the minutes of the November 16, 2010 Board of Education Meeting offered on the consent agenda, a new-hire personnel recommendation, a cardio equipment bid award, a resolution to cancel the December 14, 2010 meeting, and a closed-session resolution on negotiations. The principal action is award of Bid #9693 to All Pro Exercise, with $11,999.50 charged to the 2010/11 Student Activities Fund and $11,999.50 to the 2004 Capital Projects Fund.

**Meeting**
Special Board of Education Meeting of the Board of Trustees, Troy School District, December 6, 2010, beginning at 7:00 PM at the Administration Building, 4400 Livernois, Troy, MI 48098; district phone 248.823.4000. Items need not be taken in the order shown, and consent agenda items, unless removed, are acted on at one time. Meetings are cablecast on TS-TV Channel 19 (Comcast) and Channel 15 (WOW) every Monday and Wednesday at 2:00 and 9:00 p.m. except in July and August, and viewable at www.troy.k12.mi.us/tsdnews/video.htm.

**Agenda**
Pledge of Allegiance; Recognition; Additions & Deletions; Public Communication (Agenda Items); General - Consent Agenda (Minutes of the November 16, 2010 Board of Education Meeting); Personnel (Elementary and Secondary); Curriculum; Business (Bid Award - Cardio Equipment); Public Communication (Non-Agenda Items); Other (Cancel December 14, 2010, Board of Education Meeting); Closed Session (Negotiations); Adjournment.

**Consent Agenda - Minutes of November 16, 2010**
Held at the Services Building; Vice President Miletti called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. Present with him were Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Philippart, and Pochodylo; Ms. Underwood was absent. Also present were Superintendent Fowler; administrators Keeling, Machesky, Rajter, Stromayer, and Witt; and approximately 7 additional members of the audience. Resolutions 10-107 through 10-112 each carried Ayes 6, Nays 0, Absent Ms. Underwood. Actions: deleting item 10.A. and instead canceling the December 7, 2010 meeting while scheduling a regular meeting after the December 14, 2010 Workshop; approving consent items (minutes of October 19, 2010; minutes of the November 9, 2010 Workshop; Treasurer's Report - October 2010; Bid Award - Water Treatment Chemicals); accepting the Great Start Readiness Grant; canceling the December 7, 2010 meeting; and entering closed session. The Board moved to closed session at 7:34 p.m., reconvened at 9:32 p.m., and adjourned at 9:33 p.m. Submitted by Nancy L. Philippart, Secretary.

**Great Start Readiness Resolution (10-110)**
Citing Sections 32d and 37 through 40 and Section 38 of the State School Aid Act, the district is eligible for an allocation of $108,800 for fiscal year 2010-2011 to operate a school readiness program for 32 children. It certified it will not provide full-day preschool ($-0-, per-capita allowance of $6,600), will not provide comprehensive parent involvement and education programs ($-0-), and will provide half-day preschool education for 32 eligible four-year-old children using $108,800 at the approved per-capita allowance of $3,400. More than fifty percent of enrolled children will meet income eligibility guidelines; unallocated funds are redistributed to other eligible districts.

**Personnel**
Probationary contract for the 2010-2011 school year recommended for Jennifer Liwienski, .5 FTE Great Start Readiness Preschool Teacher, Hill Elementary. B.A., Oakland University, Rochester, MI, April 2007 (Major: Elementary Education; Minor: Language Arts); Michigan Provisional Certificate, July 2007. Resident community: Warren, Michigan.

**Business - Cardio Equipment, Bid #9693**
Bids opened October 12, 2010 for equipment at Athens and Troy High Schools; sent to 15 potential bidders with six responding, three of which were "No Bid." Reviewed with Athletic Director Mike Jolly, who recommended award to All Pro Exercise, a Michigan company that bid to specification; the other two bidders were lower in cost but not bid to specification.

| Item | Amount |
| --- | --- |
| 2010/11 Student Activities Fund | $11,999.50 |
| 2004 Capital Projects Fund | $11,999.50 |
| Total | $23,999.00 |

The bid tabulation prints column totals of $23,284.00, $23,830.00, and $23,999.00.

**Other and Closed Session**
Item 10.A. proposes canceling the December 14, 2010 Board of Education Meeting. Item 11.A. proposes a closed session under the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c), to discuss an attorney client privilege item and negotiations, by roll call vote of Miletti, Philippart, Pochodylo, Underwood, Edmunds, Fleming, and Hauff.

MINUTES OF THE NOVEMBER 16, 2010 BOARD MEETING (Services Building). Vice President Miletti called the meeting to order at 7:00 p.m. In addition to Mr. Miletti, present were Board members Edmunds, Fleming, Hauff, Philippart, and Pochodylo; Ms. Underwood was absent. Also present were Superintendent Fowler; administrators Keeling, Machesky, Rajter, Stromayer, and Witt; and approximately 7 additional members of the audience. Recognition: none. Public Communication (Agenda Items): none.

Resolution 10-107: moved by Mrs. Edmunds and supported by Mrs. Fleming that item 10.A., "CONSIDERATION: Resolution to Cancel December 7, 2010, Board of Education Meeting," be deleted under the "OTHER" section of the evening's agenda. Resolution 10-108: the above resolution was amended by Mrs. Edmunds and supported by Mrs. Fleming that the Board of Education cancel the December 7, 2010, Board of Education Meeting and take action to schedule a regular Board of Education Meeting to be held after the December 14, 2010, Board of Education Workshop. Ayes: 6; Nays: 0; Absent: Ms. Underwood.

Consent Agenda, resolution 10-109: moved by Mrs. Fleming and supported by Mr. Hauff to approve items A, B, C, and D: A. Minutes of the October 19, 2010, Board of Education Meeting; B. Minutes of the November 9, 2010, Board of Education Workshop; C. Treasurer's Report - October, 2010; D. Bid Award - Water Treatment Chemicals. Ayes: 6; Nays: 0; Absent: Ms. Underwood.

Curriculum, resolution 10-110, Great Start Readiness Grant Acceptance: moved by Mrs. Nancy Philippart and supported by Mrs. Edmunds. The whereas clauses recite the Legislature's acknowledgment of improving school readiness through quality preschool education for four-year-old children with extraordinary need of special assistance and of parenting education programs for families of all children, birth to kindergarten entry; that Sections 32d and 37 through 40 of the State School Aid Act fund comprehensive compensatory education for these children and families; and that under Section 38 of the State School Aid Act, Troy School District is eligible to receive an allocation of $108,800 for fiscal year 2010-2011 to operate a school readiness program for 32 children and/or provide comprehensive parent involvement and education programs. The resolved clauses certify that the district will not provide full-day preschool education for eligible four-year-old children and that $-0- of the stated amount, based on the approved per-capita allowance of $6,600, will be used for that purpose; that it will not provide comprehensive parent involvement and education programs for all families of children, birth to kindergarten entry, and that $-0- will be used for that purpose; that it will provide half-day preschool education for 32 eligible four-year-old children and that $108,800 of the stated amount, based on the approved per-capita allowance of $3,400, will be used specifically for that purpose; that more than fifty percent of the children enrolled will meet the income eligibility guidelines outlined in Sections 32d and 37 through 40; and that any unallocated funds shall be redistributed to other eligible districts. Ayes: 6; Nays: 0; Absent: Ms. Underwood. Personnel: none.

Business. Mark Rajter, Assistant Superintendent, Business Services, shared a budget forecast presentation with the Board and community; the narrative describes a three-year budget forecast while the marginal heading reads "Five-Year Budget Forecast Comments." He reviewed the district's enrollment numbers for the past six years along with a history of TSD budget reductions since 2002, and provided per pupil and revenue projections for a period 2011 through 2014. He discussed revenue and expenditure assumptions and scenarios of fund balances with and without budget reductions, and provided estimates of the continued proration of the state per pupil foundation allowance as well as increases in employer retirement contributions and benefit cost increases. Ms. Philippart asked Mr. Rajter whether, if the district were to fall below the $10,000,000 threshold of fund equity, it would then have to borrow funds to cover cash flow needs. Mr. Rajter stated that the district should maintain a fund balance of at least $10,000,000 in order to avoid having to borrow and pay interest. Ms. Philippart reiterated the importance of maintaining fund equity since it is primarily saved for managing cash flow and uncertain future state funding.

Other, resolution 10-111: moved by Mrs. Pochodylo and supported by Mrs. Edmunds to cancel the December 7, 2010, Board of Education Meeting. Ayes: 6; Nays: 0; Absent: Ms. Underwood.

Public Communications (Non-Agenda Items). Bria Ellis, student representative of Athens High School, reported that on November 11th Athens held a blood drive with 103 people volunteering to donate blood and 70 pints collected. Athens will team with the Troy Police for a canned food drive, hoping to beat last year's record of 3,000 cans, with cans dropped off at the Athens main office and given to Troy community members experiencing hard times. She invited everyone to the Athens Theatre Company performance of The Crucible on December 3rd, 4th, and 5th, and shared that former Athens student Danny Zerafa was diagnosed with brain cancer in 2008 during his senior year and that it has spread to his spine, making him unable to walk; a spaghetti dinner fundraiser was held at Zuccaro Banquet Center from 3 to 10 p.m. on November 27th, minimum donation $10, to help his family purchase a wheelchair accessible van. Andrew Michail, student representative of Troy High School, reported PLAN test registration that day, a practice ACT for sophomores later in the week; Troy High environmental science students analyzing the human population by recording the ages of people who passed away pre and post 1900's in the city of Troy; and a student government "Dry Run" the previous Saturday for the state national conference in spring in Traverse City. Dr. Fowler noted parent-teacher conferences Wednesday and Thursday, November 17th and 18th, throughout the district, and that the next regular Board of Education Meeting would be December 14th at 7:00 p.m. at Central Office.

Closed Session, resolution 10-112, Attorney-Client Privilege and Negotiations: moved by Ms. Philippart and supported by Mrs. Fleming that, as permitted in the Michigan Open Meetings Act, Public Act 267, Section 8(c), the Troy Board of Education shall go into closed session to discuss attorney-client privilege and negotiations. Roll call: Hauff Yes; Miletti Yes; Philippart Yes; Pochodylo Yes; Underwood Absent; Edmunds Yes; Fleming Yes. Motion carried 6 - 0. The Board moved to closed session at 7:34 p.m. and reconvened at 9:32 p.m. Adjournment moved by Mr. Hauff, supported by Mrs. Fleming; Ayes: 6; Nays: 0; Absent: Ms. Underwood; adjourned at 9:33 p.m. Respectfully submitted, Nancy L. Philippart, Secretary; NLP/jb.

PERSONNEL, ELEMENTARY AND SECONDARY (item 6.A.). New hire recommendation for a probationary contract for the 2010-2011 school year to Jennifer Liwienski, .5 FTE Great Start Readiness Preschool Teacher, Hill Elementary. Biographical sketch dated December 6, 2010: B.A., Oakland University, Rochester, MI, April 2007, Major Elementary Education, Minor Language Arts; Michigan Provisional Certificate, July 2007. Experience: Guest Teacher, Troy Schools, October 2007 to September 2010; Long Term Guest Teacher, Troy Schools, March 2009 to June 2009 and September 2008 to November 2008; Summer School Kindergarten Teacher, Troy Schools, July 2008 to August 2008; Student Teacher, Troy Schools, January 2007 to April 2007. Resident community: Warren, Michigan.

BUSINESS - CARDIO EQUIPMENT (item 8.A., Bid Award #9693). Bids were sent to 15 potential bidders with 6 responding, three of which were "No Bid"; the bids were reviewed with Mr. Mike Jolly, Athletic Director, and the award recommended to All Pro Exercise, with $11,999.50 approved as an expenditure of the 2010/11 Student Activities Fund and $11,999.50 as an expenditure of the 2004 Capital Projects Fund. A memorandum dated December 2, 2010 from Frank E. Lams, Supervisor, Purchasing and Budget, Purchasing, Business Services Department, 1140 Rankin, Troy, MI 48083, telephone 248-823-4052, fax 248-823-4077, addressed to Mark S. Rajter, Assistant Superintendent, states that on October 12, 2010 bids were opened for cardio equipment to be used at Athens and Troy High Schools, that bids were sent to 15 potential bidders with six responding (three "No Bid"), and that Mr. M. Jolly recommended award to All Pro Exercise. The award line shows All Pro Exercise at $11,999.50 (Student Activities Fund) and $11,999.50 (2010/2011 Capital Projects), total $23,999.00. The memo notes the other two bidders were lower in cost but not bid to specification, that All Pro Exercise is a Michigan company and bid to specification, and asks that the item be placed on the December 7 2010 Board agenda as an expenditure of the 2010/2011 Student Activities Fund and the 2004 Capital Projects Fund.
